teacher_bar: A strong frontier design model: decisive art direction, complete responsive composition, finished copy, no framework defaults.
common_lessons: Begin with a visual thesis and one dominant gesture; do not distribute emphasis evenly.
Use scale contrast of at least 6:1 between display type and annotations.
Create depth with crop, overlap, texture, rotation and rules before using shadows.
Alternate compression and release: dense evidence, then generous negative space.
Every decorative element must reinforce material, season, product or narrative meaning.
Write specific editorial copy; generic claims reveal generic thinking.
Mobile is a recomposition with its own rhythm, not merely stacked desktop columns.
Use short entrance motion only to clarify hierarchy and honor reduced-motion preferences.
anti_patterns: centered marketing hero followed by three equal cards
rounded SaaS cards and pill-shaped calls to action
purple gradients, glassmorphism, emoji icons or decorative dashboards
identical section padding and monotonous content density
placeholder imagery, lorem ipsum or copy that describes the component
inline styles that prevent a coherent responsive system

natural-uniform-moodboard.emotional_target: The quiet confidence of a creative director pinning tactile references to a sun-faded studio wall.
natural-uniform-moodboard.dominant_gesture: A monumental two-line title collides with an off-axis material specimen composition.
natural-uniform-moodboard.rhythm: monumental masthead → dense textile evidence → chromatic pause → human silhouettes → quiet manifesto
natural-uniform-moodboard.mobile_recomposition: Title becomes three deliberate lines; specimens form one cropped vertical procession; annotations remain visible.

linen-overshirt-product.emotional_target: Handling a considered garment in a calm atelier.
linen-overshirt-product.dominant_gesture: A cropped garment study occupies two thirds of the first viewport beside a typographic purchase ledger.
linen-overshirt-product.rhythm: product study → decision ledger → fiber proof → styling formula
linen-overshirt-product.mobile_recomposition: Gallery leads, information becomes a reading sequence, purchase action rests at the bottom edge.

seasonal-lookbook.emotional_target: Walking from late summer heat into the first cold evening.
seasonal-lookbook.dominant_gesture: Four cinematic chapters shift in temperature and weight.
seasonal-lookbook.mobile_recomposition: Each look becomes a self-contained screen with number, silhouette and formula.

capsule-wardrobe.emotional_target: Relief created by a disciplined, finite wardrobe.
capsule-wardrobe.dominant_gesture: Twelve numbered pieces form a rigorous inventory interrupted by three useful formulas.
capsule-wardrobe.mobile_recomposition: A two-column numbered inventory preserves comparison without visual noise.

fit-and-fabric-editorial.emotional_target: The authority and intimacy of an independent fashion journal.
fit-and-fabric-editorial.dominant_gesture: A thesis spans the page while a narrow chapter rail anchors a measured reading column.
fit-and-fabric-editorial.mobile_recomposition: The index becomes a horizontal chapter ribbon and notes join the reading flow.

natural-fibers-collection.emotional_target: Browsing a material library rather than scrolling an ecommerce grid.
natural-fibers-collection.dominant_gesture: Material families create horizontal chapters with tactile specimens and restrained buying controls.
natural-fibers-collection.rhythm: manifesto → filters → six material chapters → closing care note
natural-fibers-collection.mobile_recomposition: Filters become a horizontal rail and each material remains a clearly bounded chapter.
